articles.summary: At this year's Bio Innovations Midwest in Omaha on September 24-25, 2024 , Noah Helman, Founder & CEO of iMicrobes, shared exciting insights into how ethanol—commonly known as a fuel and ingredient in beer—can also be the best renewable feedstock for chemical production.
